title: Customer information APIs and event contract boundaries
workflow: Authenticate API client and validate institution membership
Authorize specific customer record and requested action at server boundary
Validate typed request, command version, duplicate identity and purpose
Apply approved state transition in authoritative CIF store
Publish minimum-data domain event through reliable outbox
Return typed response and correlate access decision to audit record
requirements: Customer search must never allow IDOR or unscoped raw identifiers
CIF write commands cannot directly post financial journals or grant payment entitlement
Partner API fields exclude document images, restricted screening findings and identity secrets
Optimistic concurrency protects identity review decisions from silent overwrite
Public IDs and internal customer numbers have documented distinction and lifecycle
Command replay must return the original safe outcome without duplicating identity cases
test_cases: Missing role denies candidate account linkage
Duplicate create-case idempotency does not create second case
Event envelope excludes document byte payloads
closure_gate: Approved OpenAPI definitions, service identity/role matrix, retention privacy review and contract/integration tests.
